title: equisetum arvense var. nemorosum
intro: Equisetum arvense var. nemorosum, commonly known as the marsh horsetail, is a perennial plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to support kidney and urinary tract health, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of marsh horsetail include its diuretic and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to reduce swelling and alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as arthritis and gout. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and silicates, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
